runs.text: Three hundred fifty six dollars. That is how far Israel is from Germany. GDP per person, in dollars, since nineteen eighty. In nineteen eighty, the UAE is far ahead. Israel makes about sixty percent of a Brit. Oil prices fall, and Saudi income halves in ten years. twenty sixteen. Israel passes France. twenty nineteen. Britain. twenty twenty two. Even Germany, for one year. In twenty twenty three, the war year, it falls back behind Germany. Turkey keeps climbing, past eighteen thousand. Egypt and Jordan stay under six. And in twenty twenty five, Israel reaches sixty thousand nine hundred. Fair point: these are dollars, so a strong shekel lifts them. Will Israel pass Germany again next year? Tell me in the comments. So how big is the gap now? Three hundred fifty six dollars.
